section_summary.extract_value: This preliminary analyses section presents descriptive statistics and intraclass correlations for daily diary variables, showing that body appreciation and body image concerns had high between-persons variance (>75%), indicating stability across the week. Correlation analyses at both within-persons and between-persons levels revealed that BMI was negatively associated with body appreciation and positively associated with body image concerns at the between-persons level, while self-compassion was positively related to body appreciation and intuitive eating.

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents preliminary analyses of a daily diary study examining relationships between body appreciation, BMI, self-compassion, intuitive eating, body image concerns, and negative affect. Table 1 displays between-persons correlations (above diagonal) and within-persons correlations (below diagonal), showing that BMI was negatively associated with body appreciation (r = −0.25) at the between-persons level, while various daily-level associations are reported for within-persons analyses.
